name: lkim3
description: Assets for the LKIM portal template (LKIM-3 design). URIs resolve against media/templates/site/lkim3/.

assets.name: template.lkim3.ltr
assets.description: The LKIM-3 presentation layer, loaded on top of Cassiopeia's compiled CSS.

assets.name: template.lkim3
assets.description: Accessibility controls, mega menu, gallery tabs, agency carousel and the visitor counter.

assets.name: template.lkim3.user.ltr
assets.description: Optional site-specific CSS. The file is not shipped; Joomla skips an asset whose file is absent, so this costs nothing until someone creates it.

assets.name: template.lkim3.user
assets.description: Optional site-specific JavaScript, loaded after the template's own.
